x: The field events were, as expected, the weakest part of our team’s performances, although Paterson’s high-jumping was magnificent and Savidge in the shot, Geoff Elliott in the decathlon and McDonald Clark in the hammer, all performed well.

Junior—6, Maclean, 29.32; 14, Courtney, 30.48; 26, Briggs, 32.04; 29, Fadden, 32.26; 32, Godfrey, 32.37; 36, Paterson, 33.01; 40, Henn, 33.27; 41, Stearman, 33[illegible]27; 42, Rice, 33.41; 46, Mitchell, 34.02.

With excellent weather and with such fine runners as the Blackheath trio Reynolds, Piper and Busby and Tom Richards, Paterson and Henning competing, it was generally anticipated that Ballington's record would be in danger, and Reynolds put up a magnificent performance in lowering it by 1 min. 20 sec…
Paterson, running for the "B" Team, caused a surprise by beaing the 2nd Belgrave man to finish and far ahead of many of our "A" Team members.
Half way round the first lap, Bagnall, Paterson, Short, Masters and Baulch were all between 20th and 30th in that order and Gebbett and Trower were in the next dozen.
